description.narrative: SWEDAC, National accreditation body of Sweden are applying for suuport for the implementation of the EU Twinning projekt "Support the Preparation for the Negotiation of the Agreement on Conformity Assessment and Acceptance of Industrial Products (ACAA)" as junior partner along with German and Austian consortie partners.

SWEDAC, Styrelsen för ackreditering och teknisk kontroll ansöker om stöd för Fas 3, genomförande av EU Twinningförslag till projektet "Support the Preparation for the Negotiation of the Agreement on Conformity Assessment and Acceptance of Industrial Products (ACAA)" som junior partner tillsammans med Tyska och Österrikiska konsortiepartners.
